findings.description: New building permits have been filed for a two-storey, two-bedroom residential infill at 1528 Newcomb Avenue in the Bayview, on a vacant lot near Third Street and the Bayview Opera House, built from eight modular pieces with a single-car garage and front porch. Roof and Realm, a Concord-based company, is both designer and developer. No construction cost or timeline has been shared.

citation.label: San Francisco YIMBY, “Permits Filed For 1528 Newcomb Avenue, San Francisco,” 14 September 2026

raw.text: Permits have been filed for a two-story residential infill at a vacant lot at 1528 Newcomb Avenue in the Bayview district of San Francisco.

findings.description: The San Francisco Planning Commission gave final approval on 11 September 2026 to a revised, 921-unit, 820-foot, 67-storey tower at 10 South Van Ness Avenue — 240 rental apartments in a podium plus 681 for-sale condominiums in the tower above, including 70 affordable units, with entitlements expiring in August 2029. The 1.59-million-square-foot scheme includes 105 parking spaces and 352 bicycle spaces. Arcadis, a Los Angeles firm, is the architect; Crescent Heights is the developer.

citation.label: San Francisco YIMBY, “Approval For Revised 10 South Van Ness Avenue, San Francisco,” 11 September 2026

raw.text: The San Francisco Planning Commission gave final approval to a revised design for the 921-unit, 820-foot skyscraper at 10 South Van Ness Avenue.

findings.note: The Registry's same-day 'Crescent Heights Wins Revised Approval for 921-Unit, 820-Foot Tower at 10 South Van Ness' (news/items/the-registry/2026-09-14.json, finding 2026-09-14-reg-0004) reports the same 11 September approval but is paywalled past its lede; this fuller, readable account carries the entry.
